steps.text: An LED only works one way round. The long leg is + (anode), the short leg is − (cathode). Here the long leg is in hole 30g. Click the hole with the short leg.

expect.hint: Hover over the LED to see where each leg is.
expect.success: Right, 31g. The − leg always goes toward GND.

steps.text: A resistor limits the current so the LED doesn't burn out. It works either way round. The colored bands tell its value: orange, orange, brown means 330 Ω.
A push button has 4 legs in two pairs. It goes across the channel, and pressing it connects row 40 to row 42.
